name: Xu Lan
source:
Audrey is an unreadable young woman. She wears a uniquely tailored black suit. Her womanly figure doesn't go with her baby face. You may into her unfathomable eyes but you will never know where they're looking at.

She rubbed shoulder with Joe and others on the scene. She sheathed her ancient battle sword and left, looking most suspicious.
